description: The flagship G30 case, and the only one of the twenty in which two fields are reddened while one message is shown: a REENTER arrival in which BOTH filters are non-numeric, so both fail edit and only the FIRST error text survives. This is precisely the state the IF WS-ERROR-MSG-OFF guard at :1056 exists for. CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT arrives as 1 - 88 CDEMO-PGM-REENTER VALUE 1 in app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy - inside the 160-byte payload communication area and nowhere else (gate G37, rule R6), which is what makes a REENTER path testable at all; nothing is held server-side. CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM equals LIT-THISPGM, so :357-358 admits 2000-RECEIVE-MAP and :969-970 move ACCTSIDI into CC-ACCT-ID and CARDSIDI into CC-CARD-NUM, eleven characters and sixteen respectively. The REENTER arm at :459-460 is NOT the arm taken - it also demands CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM NOT EQUAL LIT-THISPGM - and WHEN INPUT-ERROR at :419 precedes every AID arm in an ordered EVALUATE anyway. FIRST-ERROR-WINS IS THE WHOLE POINT OF THIS CASE. 2200-EDIT-INPUTS performs 2210-EDIT-ACCOUNT and only then 2220-EDIT-CARD [:989-993], and :311 has already SET WS-ERROR-MSG-OFF TO TRUE. ABC12345678 clears the not-supplied guard at :1007-1009 and fails the numeric test at :1017, so the rejection arm [:1003-1032, arm at :1017-1025] sets INPUT-ERROR, FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK and FLG-PROTECT-SELECT-ROWS-YES [:1018-1020] and moves the 52-character literal 'ACCOUNT FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 11 DIGIT NUMBER' [literal at :1022, MOVE at :1021-1023] into WS-ERROR-MSG PIC X(75) UNCONDITIONALLY, then zeroes CDEMO-ACCT-ID [:1024] and leaves through GO TO 2210-EDIT-ACCOUNT-EXIT [:1025]. XYZ1234567890123 then clears the mirror guard at :1042-1044 and fails :1052, so 2220-EDIT-CARD [:1036-1069, arm at :1052-1062] reaches the identical shape and sets all three of the same flags [:1053-1055] - but its own MOVE is wrapped in IF WS-ERROR-MSG-OFF [:1056-1060, the full arm at :1053-1066], and 88 WS-ERROR-MSG-OFF VALUE SPACES [:118] is no longer satisfied because 2210 has already written the account text. The card literal therefore NEVER LANDS: the surviving ERRMSGO is the ACCOUNT text, and the 52-character sixteen-digit counterpart the card paragraph would otherwise have moved is deliberately not spelled anywhere in this file, so that a grep for it over this case returns nothing and the suppression is checkable rather than merely described. Reorder the two paragraphs, or drop the guard, and the wrong message surfaces - which is exactly what gate G30 asks to be shown. Both paragraphs were read directly before this case was written: the account MOVE has no enclosing IF and the card MOVE does, an asymmetry driven purely by paragraph order and preserved as found rather than regularised (practices B4 and B5). Both literals omit the space after their comma; that is how the source spells them, so it is reproduced and not tidied (practice B4). BOTH FLAGS ARE NEVERTHELESS SET, which is what makes the outcome lopsided rather than merely partial: FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK and FLG-CARDFILTER-NOT-OK are both true and both SET FLG-PROTECT-SELECT-ROWS-YES fire, so the highlight lands on two fields while exactly one message exists. Each blank guard reads BOTH halves of its own REDEFINES pair over one backing span - CC-ACCT-ID X(11) against LOW-VALUES and SPACES with CC-ACCT-ID-N 9(11) against ZEROS, and CC-CARD-NUM X(16) with CC-CARD-NUM-N 9(16) the same way - from app/cpy/CVCRD01Y.cpy, which declares three such pairs including CC-CUST-ID X(09) / CC-CUST-ID-N 9(9) and totals 213 bytes as 5+8+7+7+75+75+11+16+9 (gate G34, practice B11). Alphabetic content in the X view is exactly where parsing the span as an integer would throw and COBOL simply compares bytes. 2250-EDIT-ARRAY opens with IF INPUT-ERROR GO TO 2250-EDIT-ARRAY-EXIT [:1073-1077], so the INSPECT TALLYING and the seven-iteration EVALUATE never run at all: I-SELECTED is never assigned and WS-ROW-CRDSELECT-ERROR stays unset on all seven rows. The three forward GO TO ... -EXIT jumps taken here [:1025, :1062, :1076] restructure to plain returns with their fall-through outcomes unchanged (rule R7); no backward, loop-forming GO TO exists in this program, so gate G32 does not apply. NO BROWSE OCCURS, and that is the decisive expectation. The INPUT-ERROR arm wraps its read in IF NOT FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK AND NOT FLG-CARDFILTER-NOT-OK PERFORM 9000-READ-FORWARD [:431-435] and here BOTH flags are set, so there is no STARTBR, no READNEXT and no ENDBR, WS-ALL-ROWS is never populated, and this case contributes NO FileStatus outcome whatsoever (gate G47) - the suppression guard is the point. The arm does still restate the identity, moving LIT-THISPGM, LIT-THISMAPSET and LIT-THISMAP into CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM, CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET and CDEMO-LAST-MAP [:424-426] and into CCARD-NEXT-PROG, CCARD-NEXT-MAPSET and CCARD-NEXT-MAP [:428-430], but it issues no XCTL: this program transfers at three sites only - :402 to LIT-MENUPGM on PF3, :538 to the card detail program and :566 to the card update program, the latter two through PROGRAM(CCARD-NEXT-PROG) - and none is reached, so no nextProgram, nextMapset or nextMap is pinned and the transaction ends RETURN_TRANSID through COMMON-RETURN [:604-619] (practice B4). All seven rows are LOW-VALUES. The row items arrive from the payload as LOW-VALUES across ACCTNOn, CRDNUMn and CRDSTSn together, so 1200-SCREEN-ARRAY-INIT finds WS-EACH-CARD(n) EQUAL LOW-VALUES on every row [:678-742] and CONTINUEs, leaving CRDSEL1O, ACCTNO1O, CRDNUM1O and CRDSTS1O, and CRDSELnO, CRDSTPnO, ACCTNOnO, CRDNUMnO and CRDSTSnO for rows two through seven, at the width-many binary zeros that MOVE LOW-VALUES TO CCRDLIAO [:643] put there - distinct from the spaces INFOMSGO and the error line's pad hold, a distinction the guards read as whole spans (practice B8). 1250-SETUP-ARRAY-ATTRIBS [:748-834] then finds its guard true twice over, LOW-VALUES and FLG-PROTECT-SELECT-ROWS-YES, so every row takes the protected branch and the row-1 asymmetry the source actually contains is visible: CRDSEL1A receives DFHBMPRF [:753] while CRDSEL2A through CRDSEL7A receive DFHBMPRO [:766, :777, :789, :801, :812, :824]. Those are xxxA items of the INPUT group, not xxxC/xxxP/xxxH/xxxV output attributes, so they have no home in this case's attributes map and the suite asserts them directly; they are recorded here so the asymmetry is never read as a translation slip, and CRDSTPnO is never written to by any path (practice B5). The '*' marker does NOT appear: its MOVE at :758 sits in the ELSE branch and needs a populated row AND WS-ROW-CRDSELECT-ERROR(1) = '1', and neither holds - so DFHRED appears with no '*' beside it. app/cpy/CSSETATY.cpy would read the same way, reddening on FLG-(field)-NOT-OK OR FLG-(field)-BLANK and adding '*' only IF FLG-(field)-BLANK and only AND CDEMO-PGM-REENTER; but COCRDLIC does not COPY CSSETATY at all, and :872-880 is this program's own inline variant, which reddens on NOT-OK alone and carries no CDEMO-PGM-REENTER guard. This case is in the REENTER state regardless, so the highlight it pins is the one both readings produce (gate G38). THE CURSOR IS THE SUBTLE PART. 1300-SETUP-SCREEN-ATTRS takes the ELSE at :843 - EIBCALEN is not zero and the program did not arrive from the menu - and both of its EVALUATEs match their NOT-OK arm, which is consecutive with the ISVALID arm and shares one body: ACCTSIDO echoes the rejected eleven characters verbatim [:845-847] rather than being blanked and ACCTSIDA takes DFHBMFSE [:848], and CARDSIDO echoes the rejected sixteen [:857-859] with DFHBMFSE into CARDSIDA [:860]. That is where this case parts company with a blank card filter, which would instead fall to WHEN CDEMO-CARD-NUM = 0 and move LOW-VALUES [:861-862]. Then, of the three cursor placements at :873-885, the first two both fire and the third does not: :872-874 reddens ACCTSIDC and moves -1 to ACCTSIDL, :877-879 reddens CARDSIDC and moves -1 to CARDSIDL, and :884-885 is skipped because IF INPUT-OK is false. Two length items therefore receive -1, and the last MOVE that fires is the card one, so the cursor field this case pins is CARDSIDL and not ACCTSIDL - the opposite of the account-only sibling, and a difference that exists only because of statement order (gate G30). That ACCTSIDL also received -1 at :874 is recorded here rather than normalised away (practice B4). 1400-SETUP-MESSAGE's first two arms are WHEN FLG-ACCTFILTER-NOT-OK and WHEN FLG-CARDFILTER-NOT-OK [:897-899], consecutive with no statements between them and sharing a single CONTINUE at :900: arm one matches, does nothing, and preserves the account text, and every later arm is unreachable - a second ordering fact in the same case. :924 then moves WS-ERROR-MSG PIC X(75) into ERRMSGO PIC X(78), so the 52-character literal is padded by 23 spaces inside X(75) and by 3 more on the widening move, 26 trailing spaces in all. The trailing guard at :926-931 is false because WS-INFO-MSG still holds the SET WS-NO-INFO-MESSAGE state from :669, so INFOMSGO keeps the 45 spaces moved at :670 and INFOMSGC keeps the DFHBMDAR moved at :671 rather than the DFHNEUTR at :929. Nothing abends: COCRDLIC contains no CALL 'CEE3ABD' and never moves anything into RETURN-CODE, so a DOUBLE validation failure still completes normally and expectedReturnCode is 0 - gates G32 and G35 do not apply to this program. The controller is invoked as a plain object with no HTTP layer and no JobLauncher in the path (gate G51). CARDDAT is seeded from the real fixture and asserted unchanged row by row at 150 bytes each - CARD-NUM X(16) at 1-16, CARD-ACCT-ID 9(11) at 17-27, CARD-CVV-CD 9(03) at 28-30, CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME X(50) at 31-80, CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE X(10) at 81-90 misspelled exactly as app/cpy/CVACT02Y.cpy:9 spells it, CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS X(01) at 91 and FILLER PIC X(59) space-filled across 92-150, offsets summed by hand from the copybook (I1, gates G19 and G21, practice B11). The seed is declared though never read, which is what makes the no-browse assertion mean something. CARDAIX [:215-217] stays declared-but-unused: one dataset, a path over the same base and never a second table (gate G45). Page size seven is untouched and is behaviour rather than configuration, so no page-size key appears anywhere in this case (gate G39). The AID travels the shared route: COPY 'CSSTRPFY' at :1416 evaluates EIBAID and its first arm, WHEN EIBAID IS EQUAL TO DFHENTER, sets CCARD-AID-ENTER; app/cpy/CVCRD01Y.cpy declares CCARD-AID PIC X(5) with sixteen 88-level conditions - ENTER, CLEAR, PA1, PA2 and PFK01 through PFK12 - one more than the fifteen the plan's summary states, a discrepancy recorded and not corrected here (practice B4). Every value above is STATICALLY DERIVED by reading app/cbl/COCRDLIC.cbl, app/cpy-bms/COCRDLI.CPY - whose 45 xxxI items are the whole payload, nine header items plus four for row one with no CRDSTP1 at :78-79, five each for rows two through seven, and INFOMSGI X(45) with ERRMSGI X(78) - app/bms/COCRDLI.bms, which declares no FKEYS field, app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD, app/cpy/CVACT02Y.cpy, app/cpy/CVCRD01Y.cpy, app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy, app/cpy/CSSTRPFY.cpy, app/cpy/CSSETATY.cpy, app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy - whose ACTIVE CCDA-TITLE02 is line 22, line 21 being commented out - and the US-ASCII fixture app/data/ASCII/carddata.txt. They were NEVER captured from a live COBOL execution, which is empirically impossible in this environment (risk R-A, practice B12), and no reference file was modified to produce them (practice B3). DFHRED, DFHBMDAR, DFHBMPRF and DFHBMPRO are named as mnemonics from common/BmsAttributes, reproduced from IBM CICS documentation because DFHBMSCA and DFHATTR are absent from this repository (risk R-D); no raw attribute byte appears in this file. This is one of twenty cases for COCRDLIC and the module is not complete until its diff count is zero across all twenty (gates G15 and G18).

fields.ERRMSGO: ACCOUNT FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 11 DIGIT NUMBER
